description: The 711 Roderic and Tariq agendas and starts, the 711 campaign and Asturian foundation descriptions and the two Gothic crown descriptions say who acts, where and why. The Roderic agenda entry also covers the earlier removal of its defender campaign choices, whose ids stay listed as retired choices so saves that hold them restore as decided stages. Names, titles, ids, operations, values, dates and news are unchanged.
